desc: Analyze operations as block swaps 0^X1^Y <-> 1^Y0^X; establish necessary invariants (1-positions mod X preserved in order, 0-positions mod Y preserved in order; counts encoded).
Implement the O(N) residue-invariant solution (sig(S)==sig(T)) with bytes parsing; confirmed passing both public samples.
Exhaustive BFS verification for all N<=12 and all X,Y: reachability components matched signature-equality classes, including X+Y>N no-move case and N=1; no counterexample found.
Edge-case reasoning: S==T, all-0/all-1, X=1 or Y=1, X+Y>N forces S==T — all consistent with the invariant.
Complexity confirmed O(N) time / O(N) memory via bytes reading, adequate for N<=5x10^5.
